name: Public Marketing Page
user: Prospective customer/visitor on a public marketing surface.
primary_task: Understand the offering and take the primary conversion action (CTA).
visual_vocabulary: Hero (single h1 + subtitle + CTA Button link + optional media scrim)
Theme + scheme switcher (0-JS links, site chrome)
accessibility: Exactly one h1 in the Hero (R-A11Y-03)
content_rules: Primary CTA is an action verb (Get started)
Tone neutral professional; plain language, short titles
Factual marketing copy; no unverified universal claims

server_contract.notes: The home has no mutation surface in v0.1: no POST, no validation, no transient feedback. All CTAs are GET links. ?theme=/?scheme= are allowlisted chrome params (themeQueryMiddleware), not list state.

no_js_flow: Complete: every CTA is a real link; the theme and scheme switchers are real 0-JS links preserving the chrome query; footer sections use native details/summary; the page renders fully server-side with zero required JS.
htmx_enhancement: None required: the v0.1 home is fully server-rendered with no HTMX enhancement. No mutation contract exists to change (R-NOJS-03 n/a).
responsive_behavior: Fluid grid (auto-fit/minmax) for feature cards; Hero and Split stack on narrow; footer grid -> stack; overlays n/a; no breakpoint-worship.
theme_requirements: Public patterns use tokens --ui-* only; zero color literals; forced-colors/reduced-motion by primitives; theme switcher stays 0-JS (?theme=).
alternatives_rejected: JS carousel for features: a fluid grid suffices (R-RESP-01)
Hero as 'Callout': naming collision resolved, Hero is promotional, Callout is the Phase D tip box
Newsletter/video/language-switcher on the v0.1 home: real Phase F patterns (F9/F10/F14) but not composed here; they belong to future marketing surfaces
rationale: Dogfoods the Phase F public patterns as the indexable single-screen flow of the protocol, validating R-SEO-01 and R-GEO-01 (clean canonical, WebSite + Organization JSON-LD) on the only indexable surface. Matches the implemented marketing home (internal/app/landing.go), which composes exactly Hero + Section Heading + Feature Card + Split + CTA Link over the shared layout.
